intent.proves: At least one validation group has a field with a rule.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomValidationGroups g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomValidations v JOIN EcomValidationRules r ON r.ValidationRuleValidationId = v.ValidationId WHERE v.ValidationGroupId = g.ValidationGroupId)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
